parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: The switch is a cylindrical control knob made of stainless steel, located on the faucet base.
parts.Functional_description: It controls the water flow and temperature by rotating or lifting the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or tilt to adjust water flow and temperature.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the base and supporting structure of the faucet, made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It provides stability and houses the internal plumbing connections.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: The spout is the curved pipe section through which water flows out, made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water flow from the faucet to the sink.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel horizontally to direct water to different areas of the sink.
